decisions.note: Locator 107801221 verifies JP 天つ風; the archaic-poetic title supports multiple natural Vietnamese renderings and no repository mapping establishes one.
Locator 10541 verifies the English-styled JP title ペガサスフルパワー！; preserve it as Pegasus Full Power! rather than calquing the Chinese wording.
Locator 100701 verifies JP セイリオス, a proper-name-like star title; without an authoritative Roman-letter spelling in repository evidence, do not canonize a guessed romanization from Chinese.
Locator 210261 verifies JP 太陽の叡智; normalize this together with sibling 大海の叡智 / 大地の叡智 instead of locking one family member independently.
Locator 412021 verifies JP 一番風呂いただきます！; the hot-spring expression is playful and context-sensitive, so a canonical Vietnamese title needs deliberate treatment.
Locator 203242 verifies JP 端緒; Khởi đầu captures its sense of an opening/beginning in a concise skill label.
Locator 103802121 verifies JP 心奪われる閃光; the Vietnamese title preserves the image of a captivating flash compactly.
Locator 105702111 verifies JP 奪目の宙乗り; 宙乗り is a distinctive aerial-performance expression and the best natural Vietnamese title is not sufficiently established.
Locator 201231 verifies JP 奇術師; Ảo thuật gia is the direct natural Vietnamese equivalent.
Locator 202701 verifies the loanword JP title シンギュラリティ; preserve the established technical English term Singularity instead of following the Chinese semantic bridge.
Locator 203162 verifies JP 後先恐れず; Bất chấp hậu quả matches the skill's risk-taking sense and stamina-cost mechanic.
Locator 204352 verifies JP 勇を奮って; several concise Vietnamese imperatives are plausible and no shared terminology evidence selects one.
Locator 203562 verifies JP 奮闘; Phấn đấu is a concise natural Vietnamese equivalent for the effort/struggle concept.
Locator 203441 verifies JP 夢の舞台へ; the Vietnamese rendering is direct, natural, and preserves the aspirational image.
